description: This file implements input handling classes for WebKit in Playwright, including keyboard, mouse, and touchscreen input methods, with functions to convert modifiers and buttons to masks, and methods to dispatch input events.

classes.name: RawKeyboardImpl
classes.description: Implements keyboard input methods for WebKit, dispatching key events.

classes.name: RawMouseImpl
classes.description: Implements mouse input methods for WebKit, dispatching mouse events.

classes.name: RawTouchscreenImpl
classes.description: Implements touchscreen tap input for WebKit.

methods.name: toModifiersMask
methods.description: Converts a set of keyboard modifiers to a bitmask.

methods.name: toButtonsMask
methods.description: Converts a set of mouse buttons to a bitmask.

methods.name: keydown
methods.description: Dispatches a key down event with modifiers and key info.

methods.name: tap
methods.description: Simulates a tap on the touchscreen.
